steps.say: 3D shapes are solid. They have faces, edges and vertices.
A face is a flat surface. A cube has 6 square faces.
An edge is where two faces meet. A cube has 12 edges.
A vertex is a corner where edges meet. A cube has 8 vertices.
Shapes with a curved surface can roll.
